name: Dill
long_description:
Dill is the leading credit-to-cash platform purpose-built for construction suppliers, including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, industrial, and building material distributors. Credit and AR teams get one platform for customer credit and accounts receivable, connected to the ERP they already use.

Product lines include: credit applications, payments, cash application, and collections.
 
Dill works with all distribution ERPs, including Epicor Prophet 21, Epicor Eclipse, Infor, and Distribution One, and is a solution partner of buying groups including AD, BLUE HAWK, and CDG. Customers go live in 2 to 6 weeks. Dill is backed by Y Combinator.
